verdict.rationale: The only natural-language evidence is Mastercard's Agent Toolkit MCP server. It lets developers ask AI tools questions about Mastercard services and generate integration code. That is a documentation and coding assistant, an adjacent feature. There is no evidence that natural-language commands can execute Open Finance operations such as fetching balances, verifying ownership or pulling transactions.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
